$Comment: Ice King mini-boss fight. Place it once with /encounter add AT_Ice_King_Encounter near the king. Waiting: the king is neutral; the first hit (health under 99%) starts the fight (hostile AT_Ice_King_Fight, boss bar, music, snow storm; they stay for every phase). Phase_1 ground (AT_Ice_King_Fight, CAE) -> 70% -> Phase_2 air (AT_Ice_King_Air, icebergs every 8 s) -> 45% -> Phase_3 Fridjitzu on the ground (AT_Ice_King_Fridjitzu, nunchucks) -> 20% -> Phase_4 enraged in the air (AT_Ice_King_Air_Enraged, icebergs every 5 s, lightning every 6-10 s). Built from vanilla Example_Boss and the Gobliterator encounter macros. 2026-10-21 reset fix: Player range 80, king Mob sensors 80, the 'king still alive' Target 120, Waiting resumes the phase that matches his health, Done goes back to Waiting with any living king. 2026-10-21: the cosmetic far lightning ('Thunder snow, far', a bolt 22-30 blocks from a player every 6-12 s) was removed (playtest: it looked like attacks fired away from him). The real lightning attack with its ground warning stays. 2026-10-21: every phase also answers the beacon AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain (ice rain: 10 shards around each player).

Sensor.$Comment: 2026-10-21: 80 (was 40). Everything below only runs while a player is this close to the encounter marker, and players farther away lose the boss bar. 40 froze the phases when the fight drifted off (the ground roles leash at 80).

Instructions.$Comment: 2026-10-21: after a reset (hot reload of this file, chunk reload, server restart, or the Done state below) the encounter starts again here while the king is already hurt. Go straight to the phase his health belongs to, lowest first: before this every reset put him back in the phase 1 role. Keep these numbers equal to the phase thresholds below (0.2 / 0.45 / 0.7).
Resume in phase 3 (Fridjitzu).
Resume in phase 2 (air).
The king took damage: start the fight (phase 1). Keep it last: the neutral king at full health also waits here.
Frost patch on the ground near each player every 2 s (the weather cannot whiten the ground; AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ground lives about 15 s).

Ice lightning attack on one player every 10-16 s: the 2.2 s vanilla Stalactite_Ground_Indicator under them, then (Delay 1.9 s, as Example_Boss SpawnInteraction Delay) a very fast strike (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Lightning, ~0.3 s) that lands as the warning ends.

Actions.$Comment: 15% of lightning strikes also freeze 1.5 s on hit.

Instructions.$Comment: Ice rain (2026-10-21): the king's AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain sends this beacon. 10 shards around every player in range, within 6 blocks, in three waves (Delay 0 / 0.4 / 0.8 s), each with the Stalactite_Ground_Indicator under it; a shard falls about 1.25 s (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Rain), so all land while the 2.2 s warnings are still on the ground. Move out of the marked spots. Offset/delay pattern of the vanilla-style AdjustPosition + ProjectToGround + SpawnInteraction Delay used by the other attacks here.

Any living king in range (a new one, or the same one coming back) restarts the encounter; Waiting resumes the right phase from his health. 2026-10-21: [0, 1] (was [0.99, 1]): health regen is off, so a hurt king never got back to 99% and the encounter stayed here for good, without boss bar or phases. A dead king is never sensed (sensors skip entities with DeathComponent), so after his death it stays Done.
